No BSC, AVAX, Base, or other EVM chain explorer results obtained this run.

D2: Protocol website (fetched) links to dev docs at dev.thorchain.org and docs.thorchain.org but no canonical deployed-contracts page was reachable. Dev docs intro page (fetched) lists API endpoints but no contract address table. No deployed_contracts_doc URL confirmed this run.

D3: Audit links point to github.com/thorchain/Resources/tree/master/Audits (GitHub fetch blocked) and CertiK Skynet. CertiK page confirms 3 third-party audits exist and 1 CertiK audit dated Oct 2021, but PDF content was not accessible this run. Code4rena 2024-06-thorchain audit repo surfaced via web search referencing THORChain_Router.sol in scope, but no address table extracted.

D4: Primary code repository is GitLab at gitlab.com/thorchain (GitHub deprecated per search result). Fetched dex_mainnet.go from GitLab returned a JS-rendered loading page with no address content. Dev docs aggregators page references whitelisted aggregator contracts at gitlab.com/thorchain/thornode/-/blob/develop/x/thorchain/aggregators/dex_mainnet.go but addresses not extractable. One aggregator example address 0x86904eb2b3c743400d03f929f2246efa80b91215 (UniSwap aggregator on ETH) surfaced from dev docs example Etherscan URL.

D5: Protocol operates across 13 chains. Only Ethereum addresses surfaced this run. Bitcoin, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche, Base, Tron, Cosmos, Solana, Doge, XRP, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash chains: zero addresses surfaced from fetched sources this run. THORChain native chain uses Bech32 addresses (thor1...) not covered by EVM explorers.

D6: No factory contract addresses were confirmed from fetched sources this run. THORChain uses TSS-managed asgard vaults (rotating multi-party addresses) rather than on-chain factory patterns on EVM chains; vault enumeration requires THORNode API. No factory children catalogued.
D7: Role taxonomy applied: RUNE token (token), RUNE token owner (owner/unknown), RUNE creator (other/eoa), UniSwap aggregator (other). All actor_class set to unknown pending on-chain reads.
D8: All four addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to fetched URLs (CertiK page for token/owner/creator; dev docs aggregators page for aggregator example). Ratchet integrity maintained.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked protocol website, dev docs (intro and aggregators pages), and CertiK Skynet audit page. 4 Ethereum addresses catalogued. THORChain Router contracts on EVM chains (the primary fund-holding surface), asgard vault addresses, aggregator whitelist addresses, and all non-Ethereum chain contracts remain undiscovered due to Etherscan fetch blocks, GitLab JS-rendering, and GitHub domain restrictions. Next run should target defipunkd surfacer URLs for the 4 discovered addresses and attempt GitLab raw file fetches for dex_mainnet.go and router deployment artifacts.

protocol_metadata.about: THORChain is a decentralized, permissionless cross-chain exchange (DEX) built on the Cosmos SDK that enables users to swap native assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, AVAX, and more) directly across 14 blockchains without wrapped tokens or bridges. Users send a single on-chain transaction with a memo to THORChain's inbound vaults; a decentralized network of ~111 bonded nodes uses Threshold Signature Scheme (TSS) to manage pooled assets and execute swaps via continuous liquidity pools (CLPs). The protocol's RUNE token is paired in every liquidity pool, used for node bonding, and denominated for all fees and yield. A newer TCY token receives 10% of protocol fees, giving holders a share of swap revenue without requiring active bonding or pooling.
